page_title: MON 1-3 COM | Monza v Como 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Giuseppe Collu is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is penalised for holding. Giuseppe Collu signals a set piece.
90+2' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and it's Anastasios Douvikas (Como) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Alex Valle (Como). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
87' Substitution. Nico Paz did his best and is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).

83' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
82' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and signals a foul after Anastasios Douvikas (Como) brought his opponent down. Free kick. Monza will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
80' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' Substitution. Tomas Palacios (Monza) replaces Danilo D'Ambrosio.
78' Sergi Roberto (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
76' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
74' Assane Diao (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
71' A substitution has been made. Lucas Da Cunha goes off and Sergi Roberto (Como) comes on.
71' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Jonathan Ikone is replaced by Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
70' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
67' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro goes off the pitch and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) comes on.
65' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
61' Dany Mota (Monza) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom left corner, but Jean Butez was alert and made an amazing save!
60' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Maximo Perrone (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Ivan Smolcic (Como) coming on for Mergim Vojvoda.
57' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
56' It will be a substitution. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Alessandro Bianco walks off.
56' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Georgios Kyriakopoulos will be replaced by Luca Caldirola (Monza).
56' Here comes a substitution. Samuele Birindelli is given a rest as he is replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza).
55' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
51' 1 - 3 Mergim Vojvoda (Como) unleashes a bullet of a strike from the edge of the penalty box and the ball ricochets into the goal off the crossbar!
50' The resulting corner from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

49' Keita Balde (Monza) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Dany Mota (Monza) uses his good position in the penalty area to his advantage and heads a rebound towards the crossbar. The keeper makes a brilliant save, though.
47' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top of the net, but Jean Butez makes a magnificent save!
46' One of the Como players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Monza have a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Maxence Caqueret (Como) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45+2' Jonathan Ikone (Como) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
45+1' Pedro Pereira (Monza) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Dany Mota (Monza) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
42' Referee Giuseppe Collu halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alessandro Nesta, then shows him a yellow.

42' Stefano Turati pulls off a great save to deny Jonathan Ikone (Como), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
40' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' 1 - 2 Goal! Assane Diao (Como) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
38' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
36' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
32' Dany Mota (Monza) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Dany Mota (Monza) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Nico Paz (Como) tries to find Maxence Caqueret, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
29' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.

27' Pedro Pereira (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
26' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
25' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
23' Dany Mota (Monza) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Keita Balde, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
21' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

20' A pass into the box finds Nico Paz (Como) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Stefano Turati denies him. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.

20' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Anastasios Douvikas (Como) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off a brilliant save.
19' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
19' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) probably handled the ball.
18' 1:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 1:2.

16' 1 - 1 Jonathan Ikone (Como) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Stefano Turati is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
14' That's unlucky! Nico Paz (Como) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
13' Assane Diao (Como) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
12' Dany Mota (Monza) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Dany Mota (Monza) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
9' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) threads a pass through to Dany Mota, but Jean Butez breaks up the move.
5' 1 - 0 Georgios Kyriakopoulos passes the ball into the penalty area. Dany Mota (Monza) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!

2' Nico Paz (Como) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. Assane Diao (Como) failed to beat the keeper. Stefano Turati expertly stopped his header from the edge of the box which he sent to the middle of the goal after a rebound.

1' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for an infringement. Como have a free kick from a promising distance.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monza will kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu is the one to supervise the game today.
